scenes.caption: A dbt model on DuckDB turns the filings into indicators, with **31** data tests. All pass.
**68** municipalities invest less than their assets wear out. Together they are **$570M** a year short.
The Province's own data has defects: its renewal-need field puts Vancouver at **41%** of replacement value a year. The pipeline screens it out and re-derives the need.
An Excel model a finance team would use: pick any of **161** municipalities and every sheet follows.
For Fernie, closing the renewal gap by 2029 needs municipal tax increases averaging **3.7%** a year.
The workbook proves its own numbers against dbt: all **17** checks pass, and CI rebuilds the Gold layer byte for byte.
